warnings.headline: Blowing snow, yellow level, Mountain areas in South-Norway
warnings.description: Local blowing snow is expected on mountain roads due to strong souteast wind and snow.
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Allow extra time for travel and driving. Follow advice and check status from transport operators. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Dress according to the weather conditions: Avoid unnecessary trips in exposed areas, and dress for the conditions.

warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Karmoey - Fedje
warnings.description: From Saturday forenoon still south and southeast near gale force 7, occasionally gale force 8. From late Saturday evening southeast gale force 8 and occasionally severe gale 9, first in southern part, Sunday forenoon gradually decreasing.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea.

warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Fedje - Maaloey
warnings.description: From Saturday forenoon still southerly near gale force 7, Saturday evening temporary decreasing, early Sunday morning increasing southerly gale force 8 and occasionally severe gale force 9.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea.

warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Maaloey - Stad
warnings.description: From early Sunday morning southerly near gale and occasionally gale force 8.
warnings.instruction: Consider not taking the boat out: Risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea.

warnings.headline: Snow, yellow level, Holmestrand, Drammen, Lier, Asker, Bærum and parts of Oslo
warnings.description: Sunday 5-15 cm of snow is expected above approx. 100 m.a.s.l, most of it during the afternoon. Below 100 m.a.s.l. large part of the precipitation is expected as sleet.
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use appropriate tires and drive according to the conditions. Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk. Travel delays: Follow advice and check status from transport operators.
areas: Holmestrand, Drammen, Lier, Asker, Bærum and parts of Oslo

warnings.headline: Ice, yellow level, Parts of Vestland and Rogaland
warnings.description: From early Sunday morning locally risk of ice due to rain freezing on cold ground and shift to milder weather. In some regions precipitation may initially fall as snow or sleet.
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Wet ice on the road: Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk.
